description: Use for 2-4 macro series side by side, for example inflation and wages. History of 2-4 indicators aligned by period. All keys must have the same frequency (all monthly, or all quarterly); otherwise the call fails and says which differ.

from.description: First month of history, YYYY-MM. Default: last 5 years.

keys.description: 2-4 indicator keys from list_macro_indicators. All keys must have the same frequency.

name: compare_macro_indicators
title: Compare indicators side by side
